claims: Lowe's stores will be closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
Lowe's stores will be open during normal business hours on Saturday, April 4, 2026.
Lowe's stores will reopen on Monday, April 6, 2026.
Lowe's store locator indicates Easter Sunday (April 5, 2026): Closed.
Lowe's store locator indicates Saturday (April 4, 2026): Normal operating hours.
Lowe's store locator indicates Monday (April 6, 2026): Normal operating hours.
The Easter Sunday closure applies to all U.S. store locations and contact centers.
